title: UNC-SEW 超低码率神经编解码器自嵌入水印
english: UNC-SEW: Ultra-low-bitrate Neural Codec Self-Embedding Watermarking
summary: 为语音嵌入不可感知的自重建水印：检出词级局部篡改（替换/删除/插入）并给出篡改接缝定位与内容恢复，信道退化时触发完整性报警。
description: 复现并改进论文 Self-embedding watermarking with ultra-low-bitrate neural codecs（arXiv 2608.25289）。发布端用 SemantiCodec（0.65 kbps）把语音压成亚 kbps 码流并作为水印以 R 份重复 LSB 嵌入，透明度 PESQ 约 4.6；接收端盲提取载荷、经神经解码器自重建参考语音，与待测语音做 DTW 帧级代价对比，实现篡改检测、接缝定位（约 4-12 ms）与区域内容恢复。本组改进（论文原版不具备）：每份载荷附 CRC16 完整性校验（水印被信道操作摧毁时报警而非静默放行）、LSB 一致性标尺通道（篡改接缝定位精度达亚帧级）。适用范围：16 kHz 单声道 3-30 秒 WAV 语音。效果限制：水印承载在浮点最低有效位，任何有损压缩（MP3 等）、重量化或强加噪都会摧毁水印（此时触发完整性报警）；能检出并恢复词级局部篡改，但无法区分'从未水印'与'水印被信道摧毁'；理论可被提取并重绘 LSB 的自适应攻击者绕过（水印无密钥，属论文口径已知边界）。任务模式：task=embed 嵌入水印并输出水印信号（float32 WAV，请勿转码为 MP3/16-bit PCM）；task=verify 检测上传音频并输出判决、帧级代价曲线、检测报告与恢复音频。处理为同步等待，单次约 5-40 秒（GPU）；服务串行处理，繁忙时返回 429 请稍后重试；结果文件保留 1 小时后自动清理，用户取消请求不中止服务端已开始的处理。
runtime: 算法服务 · GPU（T4 / 按需）

inputs.name: input_file
inputs.label: 语音 WAV（embed=原始语音；verify=待检测音频）

parameters.name: task
parameters.label: 任务模式
parameters.help: embed：原始语音 → 水印信号；verify：待测音频 → 判决/定位/恢复报告。

parameters.name: lsb_k
parameters.label: LSB 嵌入位数 k
parameters.help: 每样本嵌入位数：k 越大容量越大（R 份重复越多，抗局部篡改越强），透明度略降。论文对表口径 k=1。

parameters.name: payload_crc
parameters.label: CRC16 完整性校验
parameters.help: 本组改进：逐份载荷 CRC 校验，水印被信道摧毁时报警（论文原版会静默失效）。

parameters.name: lsb_fusion
parameters.label: LSB 标尺定位
parameters.help: 本组改进：载荷恢复后与规范位流逐帧比对，篡改接缝定位达亚帧精度（约 4-12 ms）。

examples.title: 原声 embed
examples.description: embed 任务演示：原始干净语音（AV-Deepfake1M val）→ 水印信号 x̃（PESQ≈4.6，听感无差异）。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。对比输入输出音频验证透明度；对 x̃ 再跑 verify 会得到 AUTHENTIC/verified。原始录音（未嵌水印）：verify 判 UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（fail-safe 报警侧——与水印死亡不可区分）。也可作为 embed 任务的输入素材。

examples.title: 插入
examples.description: 词级插入攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：TAMPERED（integrity=corrupted）。 篡改区间（真值）：[3.74,4.00]s。观察判决 TAMPERED、LSB 一致率在插入段塌陷、红色虚线标出插入接缝（真实位置红带）。

examples.title: 删除
examples.description: 词级删除攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：TAMPERED（integrity=corrupted）。 篡改区间（真值）：[3.73,3.75]s。观察判决 TAMPERED、帧级代价在删除段持续抬升、接缝定位亚帧精度（红带=真实删除区间）。

examples.title: 替换
examples.description: 词级替换攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：TAMPERED（integrity=corrupted）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.22,0.42]s。同说话人词级替换：判决 TAMPERED，替换段一致率塌陷（红带=真实替换区间）。

examples.title: 加噪20dB
examples.description: 加噪 20dB攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（integrity=absent）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.00,5.60]s。信道扰动：水印死亡 → integrity=absent，判 UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（水印不存在或失效）。噪声较弱时 DTW 分数本身几乎不变——靠 CRC 通道报警（本组改进）。

examples.title: 加噪10dB
examples.description: 加噪 10dB攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（integrity=absent）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.00,5.60]s。信道扰动：加噪 10dB 摧毁 LSB 载荷 → absent 报警。

examples.title: 低通
examples.description: 低通 3.4kHz攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（integrity=absent）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.00,5.60]s。信道扰动：3.4kHz 低通摧毁载荷 → absent 报警（分数反降，DTW 无判别力——靠 CRC）。

examples.title: 变调
examples.description: 变调 +2半音攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（integrity=absent）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.00,5.60]s。信道扰动：+2 半音变调摧毁载荷 → absent 报警。

examples.title: 变速
examples.description: 时长 ×1.05攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：TAMPERED（integrity=corrupted）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.00,5.88]s。信道扰动：时长 ×1.05——单同步退化：integrity=corrupted（至少 R-1 份被毁，2026-10-31 口径）→ TAMPERED 证据级报警。

examples.title: MP3
examples.description: MP3 128kbps攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（integrity=absent）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.00,5.60]s。信道扰动：MP3 128kbps 无声移除水印（论文未测）→ absent 报警。最温和的现实信道即可击穿 LSB 层。

examples.title: OGG
examples.description: OGG 64kbps攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（integrity=absent）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.00,5.60]s。信道扰动：OGG 64kbps → absent 报警。

examples.title: 平滑
examples.description: 高斯平滑 2ms攻击。原句：Literally my school and my college was Sesame Street and the people I worked with and they really took care of me.。判决：UNMARKED_OR_CHANNEL（integrity=absent）。 篡改区间（真值）：[0.00,5.60]s。信道扰动：2ms 高斯滑窗平滑 → absent 报警（分数反向，DTW 失效——CRC 兜底）。
